steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin, is there something wrong with me?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Yep, we've got a big problem.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hwuh?!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You got taller.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't scare me like that...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: This is serious. It's been two centuries since I got any taller.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Your physical indicators are all normal, and your Oripathy is pretty stable, too. Not bad.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But if you can, try not to take your rings off after you get to Londinium.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Though I guess I can't expect you to hear me on that one.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um... Dr. Warfarin, are you mad that we're going to Londinium?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Mad? Amiya, tap into your powers and look at me. How am I feeling?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Very calm.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Looks like I'm not so muddled that I can't figure out my own emotions. Not yet anyway.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Two hundred years ago, I probably would've had something to say about this. These days, though, I'm not going to get upset over something decided by destiny. If I have the time, I might as well do some more research.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Decided by destiny...? What do you mean?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Like how you're destined to fight this fight.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And Londinium's destined to face war, death, and hate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Stop. I know what you're going to say, and I've heard it more times than I care to count.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I'm not trying to blame you, and I'm not angry. If this was enough to piss me off, I would've been pissed to death centuries ago.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Here, let me draw some blood. For bloodwork.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: That reminds me, have I ever told you why I became a doctor, even though I'm a Vampire?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, I feel like you have.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think you said you used to be a very aggressive, violent lady. Because you had a thirst for blood, like the rest of your kind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, in the end, you got tired of fighting.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Oh, so I told you already, huh? Hmph, and here I just came up with a story about being a Vampire heroine. I was looking forward to duping some fools with it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't think a lot of people would fall for that...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Now that's hard to say. It might just help me rebuild my dignified image here at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your image is what it is because you keep doing things like that!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Well, fine. It's not like I actually care about this anyway.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I digress, but there's one thing I definitely haven't told you.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: The truth is, it doesn't matter how much you like doing something. If you keep doing it for a hundred years, you're bound to get tired of it. Most Vampires are sick of fighting for exactly that reason.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But at the same time, a century of doing the same thing also eventually turns it into a habit. And when everyone in your tribe has this habit, it becomes the tribe's social norm.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: In other words, it's a social norm for us Vampires to thirst for blood and war.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And, to this day, I still haven't overcome my 'social norm.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you haven't ever had any real accidents on the ship.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Of course not. I've trained myself for two whole centuries. The stuff you see me pulling is just a pastime of mine.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Don't look at me like that. I'll admit, I do lose control when I'm with the Doctor.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But about that, I've actually come up with a few new ideas ever since we started getting all this new blood on the ship. Still need some tinkering, though...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Uh, let's shelve that topic for now. Anyway, the reason I became a doctor is a simple one. I got tired of war. I got sick of it.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And I chose to reject the Vampire social norm, and while I looked for a way to overcome my instincts, I inevitably became a medical researcher.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is that how you met Dr. Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Well, she's a mysterious one, and she holds a bunch of titles, but she's a doctor alright, and I can see why you'd think that's how we met.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Though, in your view, is she really the kind of woman who'd sit down and discuss medical theory?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Or, actually, do I look like that kind of woman to you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you met each other a long time ago, didn't you?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Wait a second.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Should be this one, I think?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Wait, no, this is the book that we did together later.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: What's this stinking thing all falling apart? Oh, now I remember. This is the journal where my first dissertation was published, and I kept it after it ceased publication.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: There we go. These magazines here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: These are from decades ago!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I wrote for this magazine at the time, and then, one day, some dipshit showed up to write a long article supposedly poking holes in all my theories.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: The key thing here is that I wasn't wrong, but all the things she pointed out were indeed issues that I neglected or didn't consider.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I wasn't about to sit down and take all that from her, so I followed her reasoning and did my experiment again, and it actually gave me better results.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Back then, basically anyone could publish whatever in a magazine, and her article was one of the few that I thought was up to snuff.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And she was...?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Kal'tsit, of course. She didn't even bother to use a pen name.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You know what really pissed me off, though? I wrote a dozen or so articles after that in response but she never submitted again!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That sounds just like Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Until one day, a woman representing Theresa, the Sarkaz King, invited me to join them. She even pulled out all these magazines and told me she was that very Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhmm. So what happened next?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I blasted her out the door and never wrote for the magazine again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm, I still remember when Dr. Kal'tsit said she was going to take me to see another doctor. I thought you were her friend.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Warfarin, this is an official summons from the Royal Court! How dare you disobey us?!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Little fella, I've lived for a long time now. Do you know how many Royal Court fancy folk I've met, and how many of them I kicked right out my door?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: This is war! The fate of our kind hangs in the balance!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Ugh... W-What did you do... to me...?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Stand here for another ten seconds and your blood will start to coagulate. Fifteen seconds later, you'll be a statue. If you leave now, you can still make it out alive.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Impossible. I've never heard of a Vampire power like this!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You're welcome to stay and see for yourself.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Gah! Don't you think you can disobey the Royal Court!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Yeah, yeah. I've heard that plenty of times, too.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Eh, looks like I need to find a new place to live. Again. I've made plenty of money, so maybe it's high time I moved to Victoria.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: All this medical equipment would be a pain to haul there, though...

steps.name: Sarkaz Youth
steps.text: Hey, Warfarin, can you really turn people into statues?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Of course not. I was just scaring him.

steps.name: Sarkaz Youth
steps.text: Well, alright. I didn't know you were such a big shot, though.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Oh, shut up. I told you long ago that I'm a famous doctor among the Vampires.

steps.name: Sarkaz Youth
steps.text: None of us have ever heard of any Vampire doctors to begin with...

steps.name: Sarkaz Youth
steps.text: Why are you out here in the middle of nowhere, then?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Because I want to be.
Because we're close to the Kazdel border, which makes it easy to mail dissertations out of the country.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: What's going on today...? There's no end to this stream of unwelcome visitors, is there?

steps.name: Sarkaz Youth
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Someone seeking medical help.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Too bad. I don't treat those who fight in wars.

steps.name: Sarkaz Youth
steps.text: I'll chase her away for you, Warfarin.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: By yourself? Forget it. Better keep your blood in your body. Take the medicine and bring it home to your mother.

steps.name: Sarkaz Youth
steps.text: Uhh... okay.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your reputation precedes you here.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: It's nowhere near as thunderous as your name.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: So, what's the big idea, Kal'tsit? You, of all people, need treatment from me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not the one who needs treatment. She is.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: H-Hello.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You know my rules, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: No matter how you slice it, Theresa is fighting in this war, and you work for Theresa.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: No matter who you bring me, I won't take them as a patient.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa is dead, Warfarin. This girl is the new King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: At the time, you only came up to my elbow. At this rate, you'll be taller than me in a few years.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Four years have flashed right by.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I was actually really surprised when I first met you, too.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Because I don't look like a doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Whatever, it's not like I care about keeping up arrogant appearances like Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I remember Dr. Kal'tsit saying Rhodes Island was preparing to leave Kazdel, and the facilities onboard were in varying degrees of disrepair, so she had to take me somewhere else for treatment.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She told me she was taking me to see a Vampire doctor, but that she's special in that she likes research more than blood.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She also said that the doctor is very skilled, and that the Royal Court tries to enlist her services every time there's a war, but she always turns them down.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: She told you the truth, huh? Here I thought she'd exaggerate things to sully my name.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ahaha.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Speaking of which, may I ask you a question, Dr. Warfarin?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: If that'll get you to stop sticking a 'Doctor' in front of my name.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Theoretically, you're my superior now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm, but you're the one who saved my life. Besides, it was you and Dr. Kal'tsit who built the foundations of Rhodes Island's medical section together.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe nobody else knows that, but I do.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Ah, fine, fine. I get it. Ask away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why did you join Rhodes Island, Dr. Warfarin?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Why, to research medicine and save lives.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Rhodes Island back then isn't anything like the Rhodes Island of today. At the time we were entirely focused on getting out of Kazdel. So why did you accept Dr. Kal'tsit's request?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: How is Amiya's condition?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Physically, there's not much wrong with her, but her mental condition is a bit tricky, most likely because she's the King.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: She talks in her sleep, she unconsciously reads the emotions of others, and she has trouble controlling her powers. A normal doctor probably wouldn't know where to begin with her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's why I came to you.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And I thought you'd at least stay and help take care of the kid, but you ended up just dumping her on me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island's command has fallen into chaos after losing both Theresa and the Doctor. There are plenty of eyes trying to snoop on us too. I have to take charge and maintain order.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And given the circumstances, you made the journey all the way here to bring the new King of Sarkaz to me.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: This is the King, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Theresa's a cruel one. How could she pick a fragile little girl like her to be her successor?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Amiya is the last bit of hope she had left.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Hope is a poison to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I've heard much about your past deeds. Now that you have the living King of Sarkaz here with you, surely you've run a few ideas through your head?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Perhaps I should let the girl die painlessly in her sleep. It's a better fate than the pain and hardship she is destined to suffer.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This isn't how I wished for things to turn out either. If only it could've been another way.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But now that things have come to this, as a doctor, I just don't want to see another soul extinguish before my eyes.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: As a doctor? Giving yourself a pat on the back now, aren't you? You may be a doctor, but you're also a conspirator, a cold-blooded puppetmaster, and an accessory to a war.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't deny that, but what about you, Warfarin?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You've refused to serve each and every Royal Court. You chose to stay away from war and hide in a border town, refusing to treat anyone but the locals. The name 'Mr. Blood' has long been known far and wide across Victorian and Columbian medical circles.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You'd rather be an outlier among the Vampires. Can someone like you really save all those trying to escape from war?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I know what you're trying to do, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You told me everything about your current situation, you brought the new King of Sarkaz here for treatment, and you act like you're the losers in this conflict. It's almost like you're trying to say you have nothing to do with this war anymore.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You're trying to rope me in.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And my response is still the same as all those years ago. Not happening.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa's ideals have always been about more than just the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She set her sights far, and she had grand ambitions, but that was exactly why things turned out the way they did.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Everyone who starts a war has some wonderful ideals to circulate around.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She wanted to cure Oripathy.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Now this is the first time I ever heard about that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And we've already put the fundamentals of the research together.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Your handiwork?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Naturally.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't deny it. At some point in time, Rhodes Island will take action, because of Theresis.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But I can guarantee you—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have the power to keep yourself at arm's length.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So that's what you two talked about?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Don't get the wrong idea. I didn't accept there and then. I've heard plenty of pompous big talk in my lifetime. It takes more than that to persuade me.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But, when she came to take you away the next day, she said she'd already spread the word that Mad Doctor Warfarin had joined Rhodes Island. It was too late for me to turn her down.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I was pissed. I'd been on the run for centuries, hiding from the Royal Court, and that was all it took?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: She even had Mon3tr 'invite' and escort me to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Tell you the truth, I didn't believe her when she said she and Theresa wanted to cure Oripathy. It wasn't until she showed me the relevant research that I was convinced, albeit only barely.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: After that, I ended up staying, reluctantly.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Hey, Amiya, why the gloomy face?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Am I drawing too much blood?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Impossible. Even if I was half-asleep, I know what I'm doing.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you thinking of leaving?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Huh? How'd we get there?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I mean... We're about to enter Londinium. You're being awfully serious today, so I thought maybe you're trying to tell me—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're planning on leaving because what Rhodes Island is doing doesn't align with your goals.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Are you going to chase all the patients on the ship away?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course not. That's why we're stopped next to this mining platform.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Are you going to force me to go with you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, most of our people will be staying at Rhodes Island. This operation isn't being conducted under the Rhodes Island name.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Why would I leave, then?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I'm telling you all this today because Londinium is a big step and a new journey to you.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: As your attending physician, I should prepare a gift for you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A gift?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I don't think I've talked to anyone about this for some hundred years. It's only when I speak to Kal'tsit that I sometimes get the urge to discuss this.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: She knows just about everything, though, and a lot of it she doesn't actually need me to point out.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But, anyway, since I already started, let me go into it a little more.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Not all of those who start wars are truly fools, Amiya.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Most of them are extraordinarily smart. So smart that they know the easiest way to get what they want for themselves or their tribe is to take it from someone else.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: They know what it is they are doing. That's exactly why they're able to eliminate their enemies and spill rivers of blood without thinking twice.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And once they've accomplished their goals and built their new order, they're overthrown by the next one with an ambitious goal.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And all this will repeat over and over, almost to no end. Actually, there might just be no end to it whatsoever.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, I understand.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: *Sigh*, how I wish you didn't understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *whine*...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Oh well. There's one more thing I need to make clear.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Kal'tsit's right. I don't loathe war, per se.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I went into hiding when I decided to leave war and the Royal Court behind, and after I became a doctor, I made a rule for myself: Never treat anyone who has anything to do with warfare.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But if I truly loathed it, I should've strived to end war myself. I should have thrown myself into its midst like all those with ambitions.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I have nothing against the idea. I simply don't believe that line of thinking will lead us anywhere.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Some might think my choice is a cowardly one, because I'm tolerating and turning a blind eye to war. I may save many lives, but I've also allowed plenty more deaths to occur by inaction.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: To use a more scientific way to describe it, war is an endless internal friction. There are better ways to lead us toward the future.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: By the way, I stole that sentence from a book. Sounds cool, doesn't it? Maybe you should give it a read.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It does sound like it has a point. Which book did you steal that from?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I forgot...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Er... I'll look through my things and find it!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Oh, right. Another thing—

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: There's a reason I chose not to become an elite operator. I know there will come a day when the path before you will be devastated by the flames of war.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: That's the hill I'm going to die on, and I'm not going to change my mind for anyone.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: So if you think I'm mad or disappointed, you're not quite right.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Because I never had any expectations to begin with.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But I built Rhodes Island's blood bank with my own hands. I watched Rhodes Island's medical team grow from a few heads to the organization it is. I watched Rhodes Island grow into a pharmaceutical company.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: As long as I am confident that both you and Kal'tsit haven't abandoned your quest to overcome Oripathy...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I will stay at Rhodes Island, treating the patients here.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: This is my gift to you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I promise you that I'll...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Don't make it sound like we won't see each other again. I don't want promises, but I'd love a vial of the Doctor's blood before you go.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Well... You might need Dr. Kal'tsit's approval.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Gah, you can't always listen to Kal'tsit, you know? You need to form your own opinions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You can say that, but I won't let you take the Doctor's blood for no reason!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You need to learn some academic curiosity. I've been thinking, once you get back, you really should come intern under me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ahaha, I'll think about it.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: It's been a while since the last time I talked so much in one go. I sure could use a drink right now. Amiya, grab me that vial of blood to your right, will you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hwuh?!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Just playing with you. It's how I like to scare people these days.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: It's actually pretty fun to spook people with these Vampire stereotypes. The kids, in particular. They all go along with their shots after I pull something like that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You really shouldn't!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Say, Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I have a whole ship full of patients to care for. But don't forget, you'll always be my first patient at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: So you make sure you come back alive, okay?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will!
